name: Michelle N. Pierre
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 1B

items.text: Michelle N. Pierre is a CPS parent, a national senior executive director of strategic district consulting at New Leaders, and has served on the board of the Chicago High School for the Arts. She previously served as chief schools officer for LEARN Charter Network and chief academic officer for the Cleveland Metropolitan School District.

sentences.text: Michelle N. Pierre is a CPS parent, a national senior executive director of strategic district consulting at New Leaders, and has served on the board of the Chicago High School for the Arts.
She previously served as chief schools officer for LEARN Charter Network and chief academic officer for the Cleveland Metropolitan School District.

items.text: Her top issues are limiting property tax increases, improving reading and math instruction, and preserving school choice. In her 2024 campaign, she described herself as an independent voice. She also said during that campaign that she had raised academic performance and graduation rates and pioneered bilingual programs.
